description: The contract between the game code and the themes. The game code refers only to ids. A theme delivers the files in themes/<theme>/<id>.<format>. Assets with role "game" must exist in every theme; assets with role "theme" are used only through the theme's theme.json and can be replaced by others in a new theme.

conventions.id: Lowercase a-z, digits and hyphens, with one slash between folder and name. Ids are English words. An id is only unique as a full path: nodes/oak and resources/oak are two different assets.

priority.P1: Everything the player sees on the way up to and including the boss, except mood layers and landmarks. Delivered first.
priority.P2: What only appears after the boss or after a hidden trigger (Druid, Forestry, ash), plus the mood layers backgrounds/nebula and backgrounds/cluster-veil and the landmark silhouettes.
priority.P3: Optional decoration. None at the moment.

conventions.tintable: The file is white (#FFFFFF) everywhere, and the shape lies only in the alpha. The code colors it with the theme's colors.
conventions.seamless: The file repeats in both directions without visible seams.
conventions.missing: The game runs without the file and shows a placeholder drawn in code, so the delivery order never blocks the prototype.
conventions.png: PNG files are saved as 8-bit RGBA (or RGB for opaque files) without interlace.
conventions.edge_allowed: Transparent files must not touch the edge. Exception: entries with "edge_allowed": ["bottom"] (head-and-shoulders and waist-up portraits) are cut off at the bottom.
conventions.addon: The name of the prompt template in theme.json (prompts.addons). null means the file is not made with the image generator.
conventions.fill: How much of the canvas the subject's longest side fills (the folder's fill field, in percent). The check warns about larger deviations.

assets.used_for: The Oak activity node in Woodcutting, and the activity bar while Oak is active

assets.prompt: A broad, mature oak tree with a thick gnarled trunk and a full, rounded crown of lobed leaves, standing on a small grassy mound with visible roots.
assets.notes: Shows the tree, not firewood or logs, which are the resource icon. The silhouette must stand apart from Willow (hanging branches) and Ash (tall and slender).

assets.notes: Tied to Oak by the oak log and oak leaves. No whetstone, since it could be confused with the Whetstone building. Must clearly differ from the billhook in Nimble Felling.

assets.used_for: The Bountiful Harvest modifier (chance of double oak) in Woodcutting

assets.prompt: A woven wicker basket overflowing with short split oak logs, with acorns and oak leaves spilling over its rim.
assets.notes: Shows double yield. Must not look like the oak resource icon (a single log).

assets.used_for: The Willow activity node in Woodcutting (visible with a lock from the start), and the activity bar while Willow is active

assets.notes: Shows the tree, not willow firewood, which is the resource icon.

It is smaller than the other glyphs, because the code draws the slot frame around it, and it is shown at 24-32 px. It should resemble the filled stat glyphs (ATK etc.) as little as possible.

assets.notes: Seen from the front and never mirrored. Waist-up, cut off at the bottom. The boss may have more detail, but the face and the red light in the eyes and chest must read at 64 px. assets.used_for: The rearmost layer under the whole map, repeated in both directions (parallax about 0.2).
assets.subject: A dark midnight-indigo starry sky with many small stars of varying brightness and faint dust variation, without a focal point
assets.prompt: A dark midnight indigo deep-space sky densely scattered with tiny stars of varying size and brightness, a few slightly larger soft stars, and faint, barely visible dust variations, evenly distributed with no focal point.
assets.notes: Preferably make it procedurally with a fixed seed and wrap-around, so it is seamless by construction. Alternatively: generate only the soft dust base at 1024, make it seamless, scale it 2x, and add the stars by script at the full 2048. No constellations, lines, planets or galaxies. Base color around colors.background in theme.json, low average brightness and light dither against banding. JPG quality 90 without chroma subsampling (4:4:4), so the smallest stars survive. Test as 3×3.

assets.used_for: Fog over unexplored areas: nodes two steps away, the fog behind the lock on Ash and Druid's Unknown node after the reveal. Lies on the map plane.
assets.subject: Drifting cosmic fog of varying density, from thick banks to thin veils
assets.prompt: Soft, wispy drifting cosmic mist with varied density, from thicker billows to thin veils, evenly spread with no focal point and no hard edges.
assets.notes: Tintable: RGB is white (#FFFFFF) in every pixel, and all structure lies in the alpha (about 20-85%, no fully empty holes and no fully opaque patches). Make it as light fog on black and convert luminance to alpha. Make it seamless with a 50% offset and inpainting of the cross seam, and test as 3×3. The code makes the fog's outer edge and a dark veil underneath itself, and runs two copies at different scales and drift, so there must be no recognizable shapes.

assets.used_for: A parallax layer behind the map with large soft clouds that add depth (parallax about 0.35). The code tints it violet.
assets.subject: Large, diffuse nebula clouds with soft shapes, covering about half of the surface
assets.prompt: Large, soft, diffuse nebula clouds with broad, gentle shapes covering about half the area, no stars and no focal point.
assets.notes: Tintable: white RGB, shape in alpha. Use the full alpha range in the file; the opacity is set in theme.json. Only low-frequency shapes, so the layer holds up when shown at 2x. Seamless; test as 3×3. Light dither against banding, no pngquant.

assets.used_for: A colored veil behind each cluster, as in the concept image, where each constellation has its own colored nebula. The code tints it in the cluster's color.
assets.subject: One soft, irregular cloud that is densest in the middle and fades out completely before the edge
assets.prompt: A single soft, irregular cloud of nebula light, densest near the center and thinning out organically, fading completely well before the image border.
assets.notes: Tintable: white RGB, shape in alpha. Alpha is 0 at least 64 px from the edge. Make it as light on black and convert luminance to alpha. Not seamless.

assets.used_for: The shared background behind all portraits in combat nodes and the activity bar. The code lays the transparent portrait on top.

assets.prompt: A calm, dark midnight-indigo night sky with only a few faint stars and a very subtle soft lightening toward the center, the outer edge kept dark and empty.
assets.notes: The outermost 8% or so must be dark and empty, so the corners can be clipped round and the attack indicator along the edge stands out clearly. Symmetrical, so it looks right when the code mirrors the portrait. Used for all portraits, so they look alike side by side.
